maddeler.e:
تعتمدوا (form VIII)
# تَعْتَمِدُوا (taʕtamidū) /taʕ.ta.mi.duː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَمَدَ (iʕtamada)
# تُعْتَمَدُوا (tuʕtamadū) /tuʕ.ta.ma.duː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَمَدَ (iʕtamada)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
